Common/welcome: Hi, I'm Maya, your port instructor. Choose a layout on the console, then select Start operation. Follow the glowing pickup outline and the direction guide.
Common/align: Move the gantry and trolley toward the highlighted container. The console shows how far left, right, shipward or yardward to move.
Common/lift: You're connected. Raise the container clear of nearby stacks before travelling. Release the control to stop the winch.
Common/transfer: Carry the container to its highlighted receiving slot. The cabin monitor can show the load, destination, or port overview.
Common/land: You're over the receiving slot. Lower gently onto the deck or the supporting container. A little alignment tolerance is allowed.
Common/settle: Let the released container settle on its support while I check the delivery.
Common/accepted: Delivery accepted. Follow the console for the next task.
Common/park: All containers are placed. Return the empty spreader to the highlighted parking position.
Common/shipment_complete: Layout complete. Thank you. Please rate your head, neck, shoulder, hand and eye experience using the feedback sliders on the console.
Desktop/couple: Ready to connect. Press space to lock the highlighted container. Contact by itself does not lock it.
Desktop/release: The container is supported. Press space to release it, then let it settle.
Desktop/lower: You're above the container. To lower, press the Down Arrow key. For gentle movement, hold Left Shift while operating the hoist.
Desktop/paused: The operation is paused. To continue, click Resume or press Escape.
Quest/couple: Ready to connect. Press the right controller a button to lock the highlighted container. Contact by itself does not lock it.
Quest/release: The container is supported. Press the right controller a button to release it, then let it settle.
Quest/lower: You're above the container. To lower, push the right thumbstick down. For gentle movement, squeeze the right grip while operating the hoist.
Quest/paused: The operation is paused. To continue, point at Resume on the console and press the trigger.
Simulator/couple: Ready to connect. Hold space and tap b to lock the highlighted container. Contact by itself does not lock it.
Simulator/release: The container is supported. Hold space and tap b to release it, then let it settle.
Simulator/lower: You're above the container. To lower, hold Space and press S. For gentle movement, hold Space and G while operating the hoist.
Simulator/paused: The operation is paused. To continue, click Resume on the console using the simulated controller ray and trigger.
